text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A voice calls out to Gold Ship in her dreams, rousing her spirit. There's no time to waste! Gold Ship ventures out in search of Eden.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Convinced that Eden is a land of the divine, Gold Ship decides to become a god in order to reach it. However, Super Creek stands in her path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite Gold Ship's self-proclaimed deity powers, Super Creek deflects her attacks like it's child's play—for even gods have their makers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creek's maternal spirit transcends divinity, and Gold Ship suffers a crushing defeat in the face of her motherly love. To be continued…
